prompt: In ten-pin bowling, a strike scores 10 plus your next two balls, and an open frame scores just its pins. Your first three frames are: frame 1 a strike, frame 2 a strike, frame 3 you knock down 7 then 2. What is your total score after three frames?
explanation: Frame 1 scores 10 + 10 (next strike) + 7 = 27. Frame 2 scores 10 + 7 + 2 = 19. Frame 3 is an open frame scoring 9. Total: 27 + 19 + 9 = 55.
